intro: Tunisia is the northernmost country in Africa, with Mediterranean beaches in the north and east and the Sahara in the south.

chapters.title: Coast to desert
text: The north is green with hills and cork forests. The centre has olive groves and steppe. In the south, Chott el Djerid is a huge salt lake, and the Sahara dunes begin near Douz.
Djerba is the largest island in North Africa.

chapters.title: Climate
text: The coast is Mediterranean; the south is hot and dry.

keyTerms.meaning: A salt lake that dries in summer.
